articles.description: Numerology for October 13, 2026, indicates significant shifts in relationships and responsibilities. The Number 6 influence emphasizes commitments, comfort, and family duties. Sun-Uranus tension may lead to unexpected changes, prompting reconsideration of rigid arrangements. Individuals born under various birth numbers will experience specific vibrations affecting their personal and professional lives. Flexibility and open communication will be crucial for navigating these alterations effectively.

articles.title: Why are NFL fans calling Tom Brady a hypocrite after his Sam Darnold ‘acting’ jab
articles.description: Tom Brady drew backlash during the 49ers-Seahawks game after accusing Sam Darnold of “acting” following a late hit from Dre Greenlaw. NFL fans quickly pointed to the protection Brady received during his playing career, while previous reporting about his reluctance to pursue Darnold in Las Vegas added another wrinkle to the criticism.

articles.title: Buddhist Quote Of The Day, October 13, 2026: Why Peace Begins When You Stop Fighting Every Thought That Enters Your Mind
articles.description: Unexpected thoughts often disrupt our peace, jeopardizing focus throughout the day. The Buddhist perspective advises us to recognize and name these intrusions rather than engage with them. By silently categorizing unwanted thoughts, we can uphold our calm and clarity. Embracing kindness towards ourselves during such times promotes serenity. With consistent practice, this approach can effectively diminish intrusive thoughts and their impact on our lives.

articles.title: Bhagavad Gita Quote Today, 13 October 2026: One Lesson on Controlling Anger Before It Controls You
articles.description: In the heat of conflict, anger can obscure our judgment and distort our memories, making rational thought elusive. This emotional haze often leads to forgetting our core values, resulting in hasty remarks. By identifying the early symptoms of anger, we can navigate our responses more wisely and remain composed. Recognizing the link between our desires and anger can lessen extreme reactions during challenging moments, guiding us toward more favorable resolutions.

articles.title: 'Turn approver, resign': Rahul Gandhi to CEC Gyanesh Kumar amid 'vote chori' row
articles.description: Vote rigging: Rahul Gandhi warns Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar to resign or turn approver amid a fierce political row over alleged electoral manipulation, accusing top leaders of shielding him during massive protests in New Delhi today.

articles.title: Russia Sending Iranian Diesel To US After Deal With Trump? Bombshell Claim
articles.description: Is Russia reselling Iranian diesel to the United States? Unverified claims suggest that some of the fuel Moscow has promised to supply to Washington could have originated in Iran, raising questions about the real source of Russia’s diesel exports. US President Donald Trump has announced a deal with Russian President Vladimir Putin to release hundreds of thousands of metric tons of diesel into American and global markets in an effort to ease soaring fuel costs ahead of the November midterm elections. But Russia’s ability to meet those commitments faces a major challenge as Ukrainian drone strikes continue to hit Russian oil refineries.

articles.title: BJP protests against Congress MP Akoijam over harassment allegations
articles.description: BJP Mahila Morcha protested against Congress MP Angomcha Bimol Akoijam over sexual harassment allegations that led to his JNU dismissal. An FIR has been filed. BJP's Bansuri Swaraj slammed the Congress leadership for their silence on the matter.

articles.title: SP's Dhanraj Nathwani gets Rajya Sabha certificate, thanks Akhilesh Yadav
articles.description: Newly appointed Rajya Sabha member Dhanraj P Nathwani received his certificate and thanked Samajwadi Party chief Akhilesh Yadav. Nathwani, also Director of Reliance New Energy, vowed to contribute to Uttar Pradesh's progress in line with Yadav's vision.

articles.title: A right that fails the powerless is a privilege, says CJI Surya Kant
articles.description: CJI Surya Kant stated that a right failing the powerless is a privilege, not a right. Speaking at the NHRC Foundation Day, he stressed that human rights must reach the vulnerable and access to water requires safe, reliable supply, not just a tap.

articles.title: INDIA bloc marches to SC, protests against Election Commission, SIR
articles.description: A united opposition, the INDIA bloc, is marching to the Supreme Court to protest the Election Commission and SIR process. Leaders like Mamata Banerjee, Tejaswi Yadav, and Akhilesh Yadav have joined, with Rahul Gandhi leading the 'Chalo Dilli' call.

articles.title: INDIA bloc's massive protest against EC rocks Delhi, leaders march
articles.description: Opposition INDIA bloc leaders launched a massive protest march in Delhi against the Election Commission, alleging manipulation and subversion of democracy by the central government. The party plans to approach the Supreme Court with a petition.

articles.title: Neither approved nor disapproved, Supreme Court clarifies stance on Form 6 alterations
articles.description: Supreme Court clarifies it neither approved nor disapproved Form 6 alterations tied to Bihar SIR, noting changes post-date May 27 judgment.

articles.description: Delhi police have designated three new protest venues to minimize disruption in central Delhi. Ramlila Maidan (5 km), Burari Ground (18 km), and CBD Ground (12 km) are strategically located to ensure normal life and traffic remain unaffected during large protests. -news

articles.description: Tripura CM Manik Saha hailed civil service officers as the state's backbone, crucial for delivering welfare schemes. At a clothes distribution event, he praised the Tripura Civil Service Officers Association's humanitarian work and social participation.

articles.description: Rahul Gandhi has called for a march to the Supreme Court on Monday, uniting youth, opposition parties, and civil society. This follows a police crackdown on protestors. A memorandum will be submitted demanding an end to 'vote chori' and other issues.

articles.description: BJP MP Mallesh Babu criticised Congress President Mallikarjun Kharge's "vote chori" allegations. Kharge accused the Centre of undermining the Election Commission and announced he and Rahul Gandhi would meet the Chief Justice of India on the matter.

articles.title: KC Venugopal slams Delhi Police for assaulting journalists, protesters
articles.description: Congress's KC Venugopal slammed Amit Shah's Delhi Police, accusing them of detaining and assaulting journalists, especially women, to suppress protest coverage. He termed the city a 'torture chamber' and the Modi-Shah govt 'criminal-minded dictators'.

articles.title: Jharkhand Congress to protest CEC in Delhi over electoral roll flaws
articles.description: Jharkhand Minister Shilpi Neha Tirkey and MLA Rajesh Kachhap lead Congress workers to Delhi for a protest against CEC Gyanesh Kumar. They allege irregularities in the electoral roll revision and demand clarity from the Election Commission.

articles.title: Chhattisgarh CM credits Modi govt for decisive move against Naxalism
articles.description: Chhattisgarh CM Vishnu Deo Sai credited PM Modi's leadership for the state's success in eradicating Naxalism. He stated that Left-Wing Extremism was a major barrier to development and praised the Centre's anti-Naxal strategy and timeline.

articles.description: Former BJP MP Dharmendra Kashyap joined the Samajwadi Party after meeting its president Akhilesh Yadav in Lucknow. Kashyap, who represented the Aonla constituency twice, recently lost the 2024 Lok Sabha election to an SP candidate.

articles.title: Chinese diplomats, a Bengali play and the Naxalbari mystery: New book revisits questions over Beijing's role
articles.description: Chinese diplomats attended a politically charged play in Calcutta shortly before the Naxalbari uprising in 1967. The uprising led to questions regarding China's involvement in India's Maoist movement. Indian officials expressed concerns over Chinese diplomatic activities and their potential influence on unrest. The book 'Rebel Bastar' examines the deeper history of resistance in Bastar beyond the Maoist insurgency.

articles.title: Congress thanks CM Vijay for acknowledging the allies role in TVK's bypolls victory
articles.description: TVK, Congress, the Indian Union Muslim League (IUML) and Viduthalai Chiruthaigal Katchi (VCK) are among the constituents of the SSV alliance. The results brought renewed attention to the role of TVK's alliance partners in the ruling party's electoral performance. Congress, VCK, IUML and other allies campaigned alongside TVK candidates, with alliance leaders appearing together during the bypoll campaign.

articles.title: BJP Defends SIR, Accuses Opposition Of Politicising Exercise
articles.description: BJP spokesperson Ravi Shankar Prasad defended the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls, accusing opposition parties of politicising the process and pushing a narrative that India’s democracy is under threat. Meanwhile, protests in Delhi demanded CEC Gyanesh Kumar’s resignation.

articles.description: CJP's Saurav Das criticised the police action against protesters on Saturday, saying, "Whole Delhi has been converted into a fortress."

articles.title: 'Cops could plant evidence': CJP's Saurav Das alleges 'phone cloning' in press brief
articles.description: CJP Co-Convener Saurav Das has raised concerns over the seizure of mobile phones during the detention of party leaders in Delhi, alleging that the police did not provide a seizure memo. Das said the leaders feared their devices may have been hacked or cloned and expressed concern that documents or other material could potentially be planted on them and later presented as evidence. He claimed their phones may have been compromised, but the allegations have not been independently verified.
